title: Fox Hollow Golf Course

services.name: Pre-Paid Tee Times
services.desc: We thank you for your patience as we have switched to prepaid tee times only. This is allowing Fox Hollow GC to offer more available tee times and minimize the amounts of No-Shows and Late Cancellations. Cancellations for a full refund are required 24 hours prior to your scheduled tee time. PGA Book Rate - To reserve your spot, we will require you to prepay for the time. As soon as you check in for your tee time, we will refund the difference back to your card. Gift Cards - If you have a physical gift card, to reserve your spot, we will require you to prepay for the time. As soon as you check in for your tee time, we will refund the payment back to your card. Punch Cards - All physical
